risks.note: Management explicitly flags commodity-price volatility as a risk associated with the Company's rapid expansion (Chairman's Message).
The proposed ₹325 crore steel expansion and other capacity projects are proposed/under-construction; management flags project execution as a risk of the rapid-expansion phase.
Management flags working-capital requirements as a risk accompanying rapid business expansion and integration.
Management explicitly identifies competition as a risk it must manage while pursuing growth (Chairman's Message).

The proposed merger with KD Iron & Steel Private Limited remains subject to completion of due diligence and receipt of applicable statutory, regulatory and other approvals; non-completion would affect the Group's consolidation strategy.

Management flags business integration as a risk given the Company's four strategic acquisitions during FY26 (Shivam Pipe Industries, K D Ecosystem, Green AAC Block and Mortar, K D Infrastructures) and the proposed further merger.

The Company has significant related-party transactions with its subsidiary Shivam Pipe Industries and other KD Group entities under common promoters, which the Board itself notes may have a potential conflict of interest with the Company at large.
